title: mb-proto-socks5
description: Pure SOCKS5 wire codec. L7 protocol facts are decoded only for edge plugins; bus core receives opaque L4 frames.

commands.description: SOCKS5 commands recognized as wire facts by the codec layer. Live-ingress command support is a separate matrix owned by mesh-bus-ingress-socks5.

auth_methods.description: SOCKS5 auth method tokens the codec maps from a greeting. Unknown methods are preserved as Method::Unknown and never coerced into NoAuth. Live-ingress acceptance is a separate matrix owned by mesh-bus-ingress-socks5.

gssapi_status.description: Method::GssApi (0x01) is decoded as a wire token only. The codec performs no GSSAPI subnegotiation and the bundled mesh-bus-ingress-socks5 adapter never selects it: GSSAPI is gated off behind the adapter's default-off `gssapi` cargo feature. A client offering only GSSAPI receives the RFC1928 0x05 0xff no-acceptable-methods reply from the adapter.

command_auth_matrix.description: Authoritative four-column separation of SOCKS5 command and auth support across the codec and the two L7 adapters. The codec recognizes wire facts only; live acceptance is owned per adapter. CLAUDE.md files reference this matrix instead of restating it.

codec_recognized_commands.description: mb-proto-socks5 decodes all three as wire facts; it never decides which run live.

codec_recognized_auth.description: mb-proto-socks5 maps these greeting tokens; unknown methods are Method::Unknown, never coerced to NoAuth.

live_ingress_commands.description: mesh-bus-ingress-socks5: Connect -> ByteStream bus session, UdpAssociate -> Datagram bus session, Bind -> client-facing local TCP relay (no bus session, policy/pipeline gated).

live_ingress_auth.description: mesh-bus-ingress-socks5 negotiates NoAuth (no AuthConfig) or UserPass (AuthConfig set). GssApi is codec-recognized but never negotiated: gated off behind the default-off `gssapi` cargo feature; a GSSAPI-only greeting gets 0x05 0xff.

live_egress_stream_commands.description: mesh-bus-egress-socks5 Socks5Egress StreamEgress issues upstream CONNECT only.

live_egress_datagram_commands.description: mesh-bus-egress-socks5 Socks5UdpEgress DatagramEgress issues upstream UDP ASSOCIATE with a retained TCP control connection.

live_egress_auth.description: mesh-bus-egress-socks5 offers UserPass+NoAuth when Socks5UpstreamAuth credentials are configured, NoAuth only otherwise; an unconfigured user/pass demand is a hard failure.

reserved_byte.description: Request RSV (byte 2), reply RSV (byte 2), and UDP relay RSV (bytes 0..2) must be zero per RFC1928; a nonzero reserved byte is rejected with CodecError::ReservedNotZero.

udp_fragmentation.description: SOCKS5 UDP relay parser accepts only FRAG=0 packets.

address_types.description: ATYP values the request/reply/UDP endpoint codec encodes and decodes.

unsupported_command_reply.description: Unsupported SOCKS5 commands are represented by the RFC command-not-supported reply code.

reply_codes.description: Full RFC1928 REP code set exposed by the Reply enum for typed connect-result mapping.

failure_replies.description: RFC1928 failure REP codes exposed by the codec for typed connect-result mapping.
